escalations.title: Refusal of the 51st new-org creation
escalations.source_backed_result: First-tenant refusal remains 401 unauthenticated; desktop discovery/submit treats authentication failure as AI-only degraded state. R1-C2 owns cap defects; no clinical routing lock.

escalations.title: getCoverage queued and recent terms
escalations.source_backed_result: Queued unheld ascending and recent last12 descending-position fields match getCoverage/HTTP. PS1/PS2 snapshot fidelity and T2 snapshot.term consumer findings qualify live display.

escalations.title: coverage_event.kind
escalations.source_backed_result: Feed carries ordered full snapshots and SQL lexicographic pairs; ABO atomicity gap A1. Final post-grant state R4-D1, band/lifecycle R5 and suspension kind R6-DM5 remain canonical.

escalations.title: Receipt signature and ledger_seq
escalations.source_backed_result: Receipt ledger_seq derives grant_applied clinic_seq; feed producer helper finds grant_applied snapshot. Receipt authority/application remains R4/R6; not recounted.

escalations.title: Plan capabilities shape
escalations.source_backed_result: Plan snapshot string-array capabilities copied through mirror; companion list display fields retain snapshot names. No new capability shape defect established.

escalations.title: readCoverageEvents limit above 200
escalations.source_backed_result: Vendor method rejects missing/noninteger/outside1..200 with limit_invalid and no events/receipt;200 accepted. HTTP feed default normalization is a separate route contract.

escalations.title: Spec sentences that still contradict the amended spans
escalations.source_backed_result: Clarification transcription/workflow amendment; no additional production behavior. No workflow implementation reviewed.

escalations.title: Tombstone receipt clinic ids and coverage event
escalations.source_backed_result: Pre-grant nil-identity tombstone emits no coverage event intentionally. Existing-grant void snapshots consumed; R6 reversal/lineage findings remain canonical.

escalations.title: Transfer success results, package columns, and the early transferIn detail
escalations.source_backed_result: Transfer events/new epochs dominate older sequence in SQL; A1 fixes ABO race; PS1 missing held-deletion publication. R6 owns package/import/retry/conservation roots, including original-grant lineage.

escalations.title: Fields of queued terms and the last 12 terms on `GET /v1/coverage`
escalations.source_backed_result: HTTP queued/recent list shapes match vendor list; current used from hot, historical from used_final. T2 rejects valid snapshot.term in desktop.

escalations.title: Form of `subscription_ref` on `GET /v1/coverage`
escalations.source_backed_result: Platform/shared helper and backend deterministic AIC reference use org-derived SHA-256/Crockford recipe; no lookup or token-provided display reference authority.

escalations.title: Subscription and payments response shape
escalations.source_backed_result: ABO live snapshot/fallback/null and five commercial notice predicates match; tenant/reference payment cursor and20-row ordering match. A2 historical plan name depends on current catalogue; UI2 refresh gap; R3-M6 amount formatter inherited.

escalations.title: Subscription notice closed set
escalations.source_backed_result: Producer emits duplicate_payment,late_payment_honoured,payment_withheld,reversal_recorded,terms_held only. UI3 raw code rendering; no invented grant/denial authority.

escalations.title: Subscription snapshot when the view row is missing
escalations.source_backed_result: Missing fallback row yields snapshot null; no terms_held notice without held_count>0; flat nullable backend billing fields keep summary safe.

escalations.title: Per-tenant refresh clock and status RPC refusals
escalations.source_backed_result: Administrator membership guard and accepted-version refusal/timestamp shape match. PS3 SELECT/upsert races throttle. R1 membership lifecycle authority roots remain canonical.

escalations.title: Notice record fields
escalations.source_backed_result: SQL emits member/in_app records and grace-only integer grace_days_left; model parses them. T1 disconnected fresh notices; UI3 raw administrator code/grace omission.

escalations.title: Term days_left
escalations.source_backed_result: Final SQL floors days toward ends_at only; absent/past dates null; no ends_soon from null. No consumer recomputes grace into term days.

escalations.title: Status reason
escalations.source_backed_result: Final SQL stores snapshot reason, reads suspended before clock, nulls available/suspended reason and uses expired at read-time lapse. PS2 incorrect producer terminal reasons propagate unchanged.

escalations.title: Billing status plan, dates, and allowance figures
escalations.source_backed_result: Billing guards membership administrator then extends shared status with flat nullable plan/dates/allowance/used/counts/reference/URLs. Desktop uses flat fields; no nested term or remaining wire field invented.

escalations.title: Snapshot contract_version on the projection
escalations.source_backed_result: Projection deliberately stores no snapshot version; copies retain version. RPC echo uses request. Nested decoder compatibility remains R2-C3 canonical.

escalations.title: Task-cap split into P5.2a and P5.2b
escalations.disposition: reference-only provenance; both production effects reviewed
escalations.source_backed_result: P5.2a/b split changes ownership only. Both effective migrations reviewed together; no test/campaign implementation inspected.

escalations.title: Status view as_of
escalations.source_backed_result: Shared status as_of is read-time now(), present even absent projection, reused by billing; no write/readback timestamp confusion.

escalations.title: Coverage codes that refresh status
escalations.source_backed_result: Exact allowance_exhausted/coverage_lapsed/coverage_unknown raw codes survive HTTP/SSE to callback. T1 shows successful refresh updates disconnected state, not open host.

escalations.title: Checkout read JSON fields
escalations.source_backed_result: Checkout detail/open list parsed and resumed via CK reference; snapshot fields and null references handled. UI2 completion read refresh; lost redirect remains R3 frozen-contract recovery limit.

escalations.title: H-FS late payment and thirty payments
escalations.source_backed_result: Harness local cancellation/backdating/30-payments setup only. No harness/fixture implementation correctness review.

escalations.title: Worker N with DO N+1
escalations.source_backed_result: N to N+1 accepted/echoed N is intended; no false rollout failure claim. Unsupported/malformed DO reply handling remains R2-C2/C3; T2 separately fixes shape.

escalations.title: RPC receiver current version
escalations.source_backed_result: Test-only public RPC receiver replacement changes no published production gate. Final published gates reviewed; no variant implementation inspected.
